rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.GLOSS: Appointed; the seed set in Abel's place
content.ART_PROMPT: A young olive shoot rising from a cracked clay jar of earth beside a low stone doorway, an older snapped shoot lying dry on the step, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, deep shadowed background lit by one radiant golden light source, rich saturated blues and golds
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Look at the top two cards of the Tower. Add one of those cards to your hand and put the other card on top of the Tower.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: she called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Genesis 4:25 — “she called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: Luke 3:38 — “which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Genesis 5:3 says Adam begat a son in his own likeness, after his image - the words of Genesis 1 handed down one generation.
In the days of Seth's son Enos men began to call upon the name of the LORD.
Luke's genealogy runs backward through Seth to Adam, and only there stops at the son of God.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
